headlines.summary: T-Mobile shares hit a 52-week low after SpaceX's spectrum deal sparked satellite-disruption fears, but strong earnings, cash flow, and a Raymond James upgrade suggest the sell-off was overdone.

headlines.title: U.S. debt finds breathing room, countering energy spike
Surgical Precision, Sustainable Returns: Johnson & Johnson Secures Its Cash Flow Runway
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson posted Q3 revenue growth of 5.9% to $25.4 billion, raised guidance, and gained analyst support as its OTTAVA surgical system and talc settlement shape its long-term outlook.

headlines.title: Tesla's Robotaxi Lands in Paris—But Europe's Real Fight Is Over Cheap EVs
headlines.summary: At the Paris Motor Show, Tesla debuts its Cybercab and FSD tech in Europe while Stellantis, Renault's Dacia, and BYD showcase affordable EVs, competing on pricing, incentives, and autonomous driving.

headlines.title: Is a College Degree Even Worth the Money Anymore? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
headlines.summary: Is a $400K tuition bill really worth it for four years of partying? Jill and Mark break down how to get the most value out of your college degree, and when it might not be worth the price at all. Plus, caller Michael wants to know whether he can realistically afford the home renovation he's been eyeing.

headlines.title: IonQ Fell 9% on a $1.3 Billion Deal—Is Wall Street Missing Something?
headlines.summary: IonQ shares fell about 9% after it agreed to acquire cybersecurity firm Elisity for roughly $1.3 billion in an all-stock deal, as it expands into post-quantum enterprise security.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Earnings Miss Estimates But Reveal Broad-Based Strength
headlines.summary: JPMorgan's Q3 revenue rose 8.1% to $50.9 billion with broad-based loan and deposit growth, but adjusted earnings missed estimates amid an investment banking slowdown and reduced buybacks.

headlines.title: Flex's AI Infrastructure Spin-Off Could Unlock Hidden Value
headlines.summary: Flex launches modular Axiom AI data center racks ahead of its planned 2027 Axiom Solutions International spin-off, a move designed to separate high-margin AI infrastructure from its legacy manufacturing business.

headlines.title: A Silent Winner: Texas Instruments Anchors the AI Supercycle
headlines.summary: Texas Instruments launched new power management and telemetry chips for AI data centers, positioning its analog business as a dividend-paying infrastructure play ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct. 21.
